ownership_reason: Only the tally inspects individual sample values; Frequency keeps NaN keys by its own contract (FrequencyTest.testModeDoubleNan), so once NaN has been counted the mode list is [NaN] and the counts of the real modes are gone: no caller can pre-filter the array in one line (no NaN-removal utility exists) and no later hop can recover them. The facades' javadocs state that NaN values are ignored.
